manifest.name: dsh-meme
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 表情包插件：输入框一键发图（图库/情绪多选筛选、悬浮大图预览）、多图库开关、情绪与关键词搜图、AI 学图，图库可从市场一键安装或导入/导出 ZIP。

bundle.text:
# dsh-meme bundle patch: host plugin (send_meme + learn_meme + /dsh-memes)
# and client settings section. Activate with
# `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-meme`.
# 插件 id 仍为 dsh-expression,避免已装用户崩掉。
# name 必须是实际包名(dsh-meme)——cordis 按 name import 包,
# 写错会导致新装用户 Cannot find package 'dsh-expression'。
# 纯 insert(id/name)可热挂载免重启。图库目录不在这里写死——
# 用户在设置页下拉切换图库,保存到 ~/.dsh/dsh-expression.json;
# 默认用包内置图库(memes/dafeiyu-001)。历史教训:patch 硬编码某台机器的
# memeRoot,其他用户安装后指向不存在的目录,插件直接起不来。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-expression
      name: dsh-meme

endpoints.url: https://…/catalog.json(自定义图库目录清单地址

readme.text:
DeepSeek Harness 的表情包插件 ——
输入框一键发图，AI 按聊天气氛接梗；图库能自己养，也能从市场装。

预览表情包 · 图库市场 · 反馈问题 · English · 中文

> [!IMPORTANT] > **dsh-meme 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，不是独立应用。** > 需要先装好 DSH，再通过插件市场或 CLI 装进某个 profile；社区开源项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

- 😊 **一键发图** — 输入框旁点 😊，搜索、按图库或情绪筛选，点一张直接发送；设置页可关掉「点图直接发送」，关闭后点一张只把 `[表情: 描述]` 插到输入框光标处，按回车和文字一起发出，手滑也不会误发。
- 🎭 **主动斗图** — AI 会按聊天情绪自己找图接梗，不用等你开口；设置页可选「主动发图」四档：关闭 / 看气氛 / 活跃 / 每轮都发，也能改写提示词调整风格。
- 📱 **IM / 手机斗图** — QQ、微信、飞书等经 dsh-im 接入后，表情包以原生图片消息发出，不用写文字标记；手机/平板经电脑局域网 IP 打开 DSH Web，设置页打开「局域网访问图库」即可收发（默认关）。QQ 大图容易被客户端当图片消息拉伸，可打开「QQ 发图尺寸」把发送副本缩到 200–450px，Web 仍用原图。
- 🧠 **学会新图** — 上传图片后说「把这张图入库」，AI 自动识别分类和描述；也可以把图片文件直接拷进图库目录，点「扫描新增」一键入库（动图 GIF 建议走这条，原始动画保留；文件改名/删除后扫描会顺手清理失效记录）。
- 🗂️ **整理图库** — 跟 AI 说「列一下表情包清单」「帮我查查重复」「把这张改成 work 分类」——内置 `meme_list` / `meme_update` 维护工具，改分类/描述/关键词不用手动翻面板（删除留在面板，防误删）。
- 📦 **管理与分享** — 多图库开关、上传与编辑、ZIP 导入导出、市场安装与更新。
- 🚀 **开箱即用** — 内置大肥鱼图库（24 张），核心功能零第三方运行依赖，使用 Node 内置 SQLite；QQ 缩图是可选能力（dsh-im 已自带 sharp，未安装时按原图发送）。
▶ 在 B 站观看（56 秒）

需要 **Node.js ≥ 22.13.0**。

| 方式 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件市场（推荐） | DSH → **插件 → 添加插件**，输入 `dsh-meme` 并安装 |
| 命令行 | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-meme`，把 `web` 换成目标 profile |

装好后打开任意会话，输入框旁会出现 😊。旧包名 `dsh-expression` 已弃用，内部插件 ID 保留兼容。

**斗图：你发一张，AI 接着回一张**

**选图：搜索、图库与情绪筛选**

打开 **设置 → 表情包**： - **图库** — 卡片显示张数与占用大小，点卡片管理图片；分类下拉按真实分类筛选；「扫描新增」收编手动拷进目录的图片并清理失效记录。卡片开关决定 AI 能否使用该图库，可多选。支持新建、导入/导出 ZIP、投稿、删除和更新。 - **发现** — 预览市场图库并一键安装（Release ZIP 校验 SHA-256）。 - **设置** — 改扫描目录、主动发图（关闭/看气氛/活跃/每轮都发）、提示词、发送方式（自动/纯文字/图片）、QQ 发图尺寸（开关 + 200/300/400/450px 长边）、表情排布（并排/独占一行）、局域网访问、`AGENTS.md`。
设置页截图（展开查看） **图库：已安装图库与独立开关**

**发现：市场图库预览与一键安装**

**设置：发送方式、主动发图与图库目录**

默认扫描 `~/.dsh/meme-packs`，设置存 `~/.dsh/dsh-expression.json`，升级保留。ZIP 支持常规压缩和纯图片目录。

**发送方式**只影响 AI：自动按渠道（Web 写标记、IM 发原图）、纯文字不发图、图片要求每次真发。**主动发图**四档：关闭（只在你明确要图时发）、看气氛（默认，AI 自己判断）、活跃（大部分合适的回合都发）、每轮都发（提示词强制要求发一张）；仅在「自动」发送方式下生效，切换后新开会话生效，你明确要图时不受档位限制。**QQ 发图尺寸**默认关；打开后 QQ/IM 发送前把长边缩到所选尺寸（默认 300px），Web 聊天仍用原图，GIF 保留动画——QQ 官方机器人没有表情消息类型，缩小后更容易被客户端按表情渲染，平板端不会拉伸满屏。**表情排布**只影响前端：并排（默认）或图独占一行。

- **QQ 发表情被当大图拉伸** — QQ 官方机器人没有表情消息类型，大图会按图片消息渲染。设置页打开「QQ 发图尺寸」，选 300px（经验区间 200–450）后，QQ/IM 会发送缩小副本，Web 仍用原图；缩放需要 sharp，dsh-im 已自带，未安装时自动按原图发送。
- **更新失败 / 插件消失** — 先在市场点「重试」；仍失败就完全退出 DSH 后再更新。更早版本或仍失败，退出 DSH 后在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm add dsh-meme@latest`。图库和设置都在 `~/.dsh`，重装不丢。详见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。
- **国内网络 / 市场拉不到** — 默认多镜像竞速 + 磁盘缓存，通常无需配置；拉不到时先在发现页点「重试」，再把「图库目录源」切到「镜像源」。详见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。
- **手机 / 局域网 / 反向代理 / 子路径** — 局域网 IP 访问在设置页打开「局域网访问图库」；反代域名需显式声明可信 Host（`DSH_MEME_TRUSTED_HOSTS` 或 `allowedHosts`）；子路径部署（fnOS `/app/<id>/`、Nginx `location /dsh/` 等）从 0.1.77 起自动适配，无需配置。详见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。
在「图库」新建图包库并加图 → **导出** ZIP 给朋友 **导入**。想进市场就点 **投稿**，按预填表单附上 ZIP、图片来源与许可。请用插件导出的 ZIP；GitHub 的「Download ZIP」是源码包，不能替代图库包。

| 工具 | 用法 |
| --- | --- |
| `send_meme` | 按情绪 `tag` 随机抽图，或按 `query` 搜描述/关键词/文件名；跨所有启用图库，候选带 `path`（磁盘绝对路径）/ `library`，IM 场景另有 `absPath`；没命中时返回真实分类统计 |
| `learn_meme` | 收录最近一张用户图片，也可指定 `attachmentId` / `imageUrl`；附件 GIF 被压成单帧时会提示 |
| `meme_list` | 跨启用图库按关键词/分类/图库筛清单，带所属图库、分类、描述、关键词和 path |
| `meme_update` | 改一张图的分类/描述/关键词（只改索引不动文件）；path 用 `meme_list` / `send_meme` 的原样 |

```text
send_meme tag=happy
send_meme query="猫 比心"
learn_meme
meme_list tag=work

情绪桶：`happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `shy` / `confused` / `daily`。模型应把候选里的 `[表情: 描述]` 原样写进回复；没有合适的候选就换关键词或纯文字回复。

**给 agent 的说明**：包内 `AGENTS.md` 写了发图判定、path 前缀和 GIF 压平的坑；图库整理流程在 skill `.dsh/skills/dsh-meme-maintenance` 里。设置页可直接查看/编辑。

**动图读取**：`learn_meme` 和上传识图会把 GIF 采样成多帧胶片条再送模型，caption 能描述动作；原图仍保留动画。WebP / APNG 只读元数据、按第一帧识别。
经 [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) 接入后，`send_meme` 候选带绝对路径，模型调用 `dsh_im_return_file` 发原生图片；Web 聊天仍用 `[表情: 描述]`。通过 [dsh-companion](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-companion) 也可接 QQ。

对 [dsh-qqbot](https://github.com/tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot) 会话，候选带 `absPath`，交给 `qqbot_send_file` 的 `file_path`。dsh-qqbot 默认有路径白名单，需要把图库目录加进 `sendFile.extraRoots`：

```yaml

readme.section: qqbot profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（或「设置 → QQ 机器人」）
readme.text:
- id: im-qqbot
  config:
    sendFile:
      extraRoots:
        - C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\meme-packs
        - C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-meme\memes
```

`C:\Users\<你>` 在 Linux/macOS 上换成 `~`；图库放哪就加哪个目录，内置图库的路径也要加。

readme.section: 给其它插件的只读取图服务
readme.text:
同进程插件可用 `ctx.get('dshMeme')` 直接检索/挑图（只读）：

| 方法 | 返回 |
| --- | --- |
| `packs()` | 已启用图库 `{ id, name, count, path }[]` |
| `search({ query, tag, limit })` | `{ ok, query, memes: [{ path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }] }` |
| `pick({ query, tag })` | 命中 `{ ok: true, path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }`；否则 `{ ok: false, reason, tags, tagStats }` |

`tag` 是情绪桶；未命中时 `tagStats` 给出真实分类分布。返回的 `path` 是磁盘绝对路径且文件存在。自建图库目录或市场源见 [远程图库规范](./docs/remote-pack-spec.md)。

readme.section: 给其它插件的只读取图服务
readme.text: 插件 HTTP 接口默认只接受回环 Host；手机/局域网与反向代理的配置见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。

纯 ESM，没有构建步骤。克隆仓库后直接跑测试：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme.git
cd dsh-meme
npm test
```

测试用 Node 内置 test runner（`node --test test/*.test.mjs`），发版前应全绿。本机用 `link:` 装进 profile 时，改完代码重启 DSH 即生效；给 agent 的硬约定见 [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md)。

- 遇到问题先看 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)，没解决就 [开 issue](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/issues/new/choose)。
- 交流群：[QQ 1 群（已满）](https://qm.qq.com/q/7AD2g70HqS) · [dsh 插件 2 群](https://qm.qq.com/q/HCtId2UY4q)
- 版本更新见 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-meme?activeTab=versions)。

- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — 上游 agent 平台
- [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) — QQ / 微信 / 飞书等 IM 接入，表情包以原生图片发送
- [dsh-meme-packs](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme-packs) — 可下载图库与机器可读目录
- [dsh-companion](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-companion) — 陪伴模式插件，也能接 QQ 通道
- [agent-expression](https://github.com/yyh-001/agent-expression) — 同一套图库思路的本地 Skill，适配 OpenClaw / Hermes / Cursor
代码采用 [MIT](./LICENSE) 许可。内置、市场与第三方图库的图片版权与使用范围见各图库说明。

A meme plugin for DeepSeek Harness —
one-click sending from the composer, mood-aware AI replies, and packs you can grow or install from the marketplace.
Pack showcase · Pack marketplace · Report an issue · 中文 · English

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **dsh-meme is a DeepSeek Harness plugin, not a standalone app.**  
> Install DSH first, then add the plugin through the marketplace or CLI into a profile. It is a community open-source project, not an official DeepSeek product.

- 😊 **Click to send** — open 😊 beside the composer, search or filter by pack and mood, and pick an image to send it. Turn off “Click to send” in settings and picking only inserts the marker at your caret, so text and sticker go out together on Enter without accidental sends.
- 🎭 **Proactive memes** — the AI picks a meme that fits the conversation's mood without waiting to be asked; choose a proactive-meme level (off / by mood / active / every turn) or edit the prompt in settings.
- 📱 **IM / mobile** — through dsh-im, QQ / WeChat / Feishu and other IM chats send memes as native images with no text marker; on a phone or tablet, open DSH Web over your computer's LAN IP and turn on “Allow LAN access” (off by default). QQ tends to render large images as photos (stretched full-screen on tablets); turn on “QQ send size” in settings to send a 200–450 px copy while Web keeps the original.
- 🧠 **Learn new images** — upload an image and ask to save it; the AI identifies its category and caption. You can also drop image files into a pack folder and click “扫描新增 (Scan)” — the original bytes (including animated GIFs) are kept, and renamed/deleted files have their stale index rows cleaned up.
- 🗂️
▶ Watch on Bilibili (56s)

Requires **Node.js ≥ 22.13.0**.

| Method | How |
| --- | --- |
| Marketplace (recommended) | DSH → **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-meme`, and install |
| CLI | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-meme` (replace `web` with the target profile) |

Once installed, 😊 appears beside the composer in any conversation. The old package name `dsh-expression` is deprecated; its internal plugin ID is retained for compatibility.

**Meme exchange: you send one, the AI replies with one**

**Picker: search, packs and mood filters**

- **图库 (Packs)** — cards show image count and disk size; click a card to manage images. The category dropdown filters by real categories; “扫描新增 (Scan)” indexes images you copied into the folder and cleans up stale rows. Each switch controls whether the AI can use that pack; several can be enabled. Create, import/export ZIPs, submit, delete and update.
- **发现 (Discover)** — preview marketplace packs and install them (Release ZIPs verify SHA-256).
- **设置 (Settings)** — scan directory, proactive memes (off / by mood / active / every turn), prompt, send mode (automatic / text-only / image), QQ send size (toggle + 200/300/400/450 px long edge), layout (side-by-side / full-width row), LAN access, `AGENTS.md`.

Settings screenshots (expand) **Packs: installed packs with independent switches**

**Discover: marketplace previews and one-click install**

**Settings: send mode, proactive memes and pack directory**
The default scan directory is `~/.dsh/meme-packs`; settings live in `~/.dsh/dsh-expression.json` and survive upgrades. ZIP imports accept standard compression and plain image folders.

**Send mode** only affects the AI: automatic follows the channel (Web marker, IM native image), text-only never sends images, image requires a real send every time. **Proactive memes** has four levels: off (only when you ask for one), by mood (default, the AI decides), active (most suitable turns), and every turn (the prompt requires one); they apply only in automatic send mode, take effect in a new session, and a direct request always bypasses the level. **QQ send size** is off by default; when enabled, QQ/IM sends a copy scaled to the selected long edge (300 px default), Web keeps the original, and GIF frames are preserved — the official QQ bot has no sticker message type, and smaller images are more likely to render as stickers instead of being stretched full-screen on tablets. **Layout** only affects rendering: side-by-side (default) or a full-width image row.

- **QQ renders memes as stretched photos** — the official QQ bot has no sticker message type, so large images are sent as photos. Turn on “QQ send size” and pick 300 px (200–450 works best); QQ/IM then sends a scaled copy while Web keeps the original. Scaling needs sharp, which dsh-im bundles; without it the original image is sent.
- **Update failed / plugin disappeared** — click **Retry** in the marketplace; if it still fails, quit DSH completely and update again. On older versions, or if it keeps failing, run `pnpm add dsh-meme@latest` in the profile directory with DSH closed. Packs and settings live in `~/.dsh` and survive reinstalls. See the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md).
- **Restrictive network / marketplace unavailable** — mirrors are raced and the catalog is cached automatically; click **Retry**, then switch **Catalog source** to **Mirrors**. See the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md).
- **Phone / LAN / reverse proxy / sub-path** — turn on **Allow LAN access** for LAN IPs; a reverse-proxy domain needs an explicit trusted host (`DSH_MEME_TRUSTED_H

Create a pack, add images, click **导出 (Export)** and send the ZIP; friends install it with **导入图库 (Import pack)**. To join the marketplace, click **投稿 (Submit)** and attach the ZIP with image sources and licence details in the prefilled GitHub form. Use the plugin's exported ZIP — GitHub's “Download ZIP” is a source archive, not a pack.

| Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| `send_meme` | `tag` samples a mood bucket, `query` searches captions/keywords/file names across enabled packs; candidates carry `path` (absolute on disk) / `library`, plus `absPath` for IM, and a miss returns real category counts |
| `learn_meme` | Saves the latest user image by default; also accepts `attachmentId` / `imageUrl`; warns when an attached GIF was flattened |
| `meme_list` | Read-only listing across enabled packs by keyword/category/pack, with pack, category, caption, keywords and path |
| `meme_update` | Change one image's category/caption/keywords (index only); pass the path exactly as returned by `meme_list` / `send_meme` |

```text
send_meme tag=happy
send_meme query="猫 比心"
learn_meme
meme_list tag=work

Mood buckets: `happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `shy` / `confused` / `daily`. The model should copy a candidate's `[表情: caption]` verbatim; if nothing fits, retry with other words or reply with text.

**Agent docs**: `AGENTS.md` documents per-channel sending, path prefixes and the GIF-flattening caveat; pack maintenance lives in the skill `.dsh/skills/dsh-meme-maintenance`. The settings page can view/edit it.

**Animated GIFs**: `learn_meme` and upload recognition sample GIF frames into a filmstrip, so captions describe motion; the original keeps animating. WebP / APNG contribute metadata only and are recognized from the first frame.

Through [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im), `send_meme` candidates carry absolute paths and the model calls `dsh_im_return_file`; Web chats keep `[表情: caption]`. [dsh-companion](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-companion) also provides QQ delivery.

For [dsh-qqbot](https://github.com/tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot) sessions, candidates carry `absPath` for `qqbot_send_file`'s `file_path`. dsh-qqbot's path allowlist needs your pack directories in `sendFile.extraRoots`:

```yaml

readme.section: the qqbot profile's cordis.patch.yml (or Settings → QQ bot)
readme.text:
- id: im-qqbot
  config:
    sendFile:
      extraRoots:
        - C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\meme-packs
        - C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-meme\memes
```

Replace `C:\Users\<you>` with `~` on Linux/macOS; include the bundled pack's path too.

readme.section: Read-only meme service for other plugins
readme.text:
Other plugins in the same process can call `ctx.get('dshMeme')` (read-only):

| Method | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `packs()` | Enabled packs `{ id, name, count, path }[]` |
| `search({ query, tag, limit })` | `{ ok, query, memes: [{ path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }] }` |
| `pick({ query, tag })` | On a hit `{ ok: true, path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }`; otherwise `{ ok: false, reason, tags, tagStats }` |

readme.section: Read-only meme service for other plugins
readme.text:
`tag` is a mood bucket; `tagStats` gives the real category distribution on a miss. Every returned `path` is absolute and exists. For custom catalogs see the [remote pack specification](./docs/remote-pack-spec.md).

Plugin HTTP routes accept loopback hosts by default; LAN and reverse-proxy setup is in the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md).

Plain ESM, no build step. Clone the repository and run the tests:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme.git
cd dsh-meme
npm test
```

Tests use Node's built-in runner (`node --test test/*.test.mjs`) and should be green before a release. With a `link:` install into a profile, restart DSH to pick up changes. Agent-facing conventions live in [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md).

- Check the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md) first, then [open an issue](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/issues/new/choose).
- Chat: [QQ group 1 (full)](https://qm.qq.com/q/7AD2g70HqS) · [QQ group 2 for dsh plugins](https://qm.qq.com/q/HCtId2UY4q)
- Version history: [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-meme?activeTab=versions).

- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — the upstream agent platform
- [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) — QQ / WeChat / Feishu IM bridge that delivers memes as native images
- [dsh-meme-packs](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme-packs) — downloadable packs and a machine-readable catalog
- [dsh-companion](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-companion) — companion-mode plugin with an optional QQ channel
- [agent-expression](https://github.com/yyh-001/agent-expression) — a local skill with the same pack idea, for OpenClaw / Hermes / Cursor
